system.description:
For a Tzimisce who has mastered Ecstatic Agony, pain becomes power. The more wounded he is, the more potent he becomes: the Fiend delights in every slash, punch, bullet, or burn, and channels his pain into physical prowess and incredible displays of Caine's Gifts.

System: After the player spends two Willpower points, the character becomes more powerful when experiencing pain for the rest of the scene. For all non-reflexive actions involving a Physical Attribute or the use of a Discipline, add his current wound penalty to the dice pool (for example, add two dice at the Wounded health level). As the character heals, this bonus wanes; treat Incapacitated and Final Death normally.

MET System: Spend a Willpower Trait to activate Ecstatic Agony. For the duration of a scene, you gain two bonus Physical Traits for each health level of damage you suffer in combat, potentially raising your Physical Trait pool above your normal generation limit. Healing damage loses any bonus Traits earned this way. If you possess any ability that lets you ignore wound penalties in combat, you gain no benefit from Ecstatic Agony.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
